title: Specialty Domain Pack
description: Metadata definition for a clinical or product specialty mapping pack

name.description: Kebab-case machine identifier for the pack (e.g. oncology-ngs-biomarker)

title.description: Human-readable title of the specialty pack

description.description: Short description of what mapping cases and scope this pack covers

cases.description: List of case JSON file names associated with this pack (e.g. condition--condition-occurrence--oncology-diagnosis.json)

description_file.description: Path to the markdown file detailing clinical samples/narrative, relative to the pack folder

fhirVersion.description: The FHIR specification version this pack is designed for (e.g., R4, 4.0.1)

omopCdmVersion.description: The OMOP CDM version this pack targets (e.g., 5.4)

omopExtension.description: The name of the OMOP CDM extension used, if applicable (e.g., Oncology WG Genomic Extension)

omopExtensionVersion.description: The version of the OMOP CDM extension used, if applicable
